name: Equinox Gold Corp.
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025: the securities registered under Section 12(b) are the company's common shares, trading symbol EQX, listed directly on the NYSE American (and on the TSX under the same symbol) — the NYSE American security is the common share itself, not an ADS; company disclosure in its own releases states 'Equinox Gold's common shares are listed on the TSX and the NYSE American under the trading symbol EQX'
ads_ratio.reason: Equinox is a direct-listed foreign private issuer: one NYSE American-traded EQX share is one common share, so no ADS conversion applies; per-share figures and the traded price are on the same basis.

f_subtype_basis: sum of the last 3 fiscal years (the median window)
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 27.5%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 40-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025: the securities registered under Section 12(b) are the company's common shares, trading symbol EQX, listed directly on the NYSE American (and on the TSX under the same symbol) — the NYSE American security is the common share itself, not an ADS; company disclosure in its own releases states 'Equinox Gold's common shares are listed on the TSX and the NYSE American under the trading symbol EQX') so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
note: No positive NORMALIZED (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings — OE DCF not supportable on numbers alone. If the latest year alone is positive, that is a flag to investigate, not a pass. F sub-type: no cash generation (OCF - capex is not positive).
